newsitem.title: INDIA: India to remove ceiling on 10-yr external loans.
newsitem.headline: India to remove ceiling on 10-yr external loans.

text.p: The Indian government has decided to remove the ceiling on external commercial borrowings (ECBs) with maturities of more than 10 years, a Finance Ministry official said on Friday.
"The government has decided to do away with ECB ceilings on loans with maturity above 10 years," the official told Reuters.
Currently the government limits how much individual companies can borrow overseas. The official did not say what the current ceiling on loans of more than 10 years maturity is.
The official said the government expected to release a statement on the decision to scrap the borrowing ceiling later on Friday.
